summary: First-run full e2e testing. Backend: 32/32 pytest cases pass across auth, RBAC/scope (customer/DJ/admin), events (locked fields, 403 on date), messages (send/pin/read/notifications), music CRUD, timeline (suggest/confirm/403 on confirmed), files (upload + staff file 403), invitations (templates visibility by role + public share by token), admin overview, create-customer-with-login, WordPress sync (401 on wrong key, upsert idempotency). Frontend smoke: customer login lands on /event/<id> showing 'Jeroen & Mark', 'Bruiloft · 14 juni 2027', 85% progress, 6 cards; wrong password shows Dutch error 'Onjuist e-mailadres of wachtwoord'; customer navigating to /admin is redirected back to event page; admin login reaches /admin dashboard with counts (3 upcoming / 2 attention / 0 unread / 1 incomplete) and lists; mobile viewport (390px) renders event dashboard & chat cleanly, message send works with read-check indicator.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS='*' is set in backend/.env while allow_credentials=True — Starlette will send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, which browsers reject for credentialed cross-origin requests. Currently works because frontend uses same-origin via ingress, but should be tightened to the actual frontend origin for defense-in-depth and future deployments.

login brute-force lockout keeps extending locked_until on every failed attempt even after count>=5; combined with 'count>=5 and locked_until>now()' this means repeated failures effectively prolong the lockout indefinitely instead of a fixed 15 min window. Minor UX issue.
routes/invitations.py public_invitation_photo bypasses scope — any caller with the share token can also fetch the photo; this is intended but note no rate-limit.
test_create_dj in backend_test wasn't able to clean up a created TEST_DJ via API (no DELETE /djs endpoint); cleaned via DB. Consider adding DELETE /djs/{id} for admin UI parity.

events DELETE cascades but does NOT remove the users row linked to the customer; may leave orphan user accounts when deleting customers (delete_customer deletes users where customer_id=... which is good; but delete_event does not touch users — fine). No change needed.
test_credentials: see /app/memory/test_credentials.md (used admin bojan.vanderheide@gmail.com, customer jeroen@example.nl, DJ bas@white-vision.nl, all Demo!2027)
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data added. All TEST_* records cleaned up via API in test teardown and a final mongosh sweep removed any residuals (messages, djs, customers, events, music_items, timeline_items, invitation_templates, test users).

The admin, DJ (bas/thomas), and two customer accounts are confirmed functional. WP_API_KEY lives in backend/.env (currently wWMOJEud8qmODhJgNvbNdx8r77c_xWd3).
